card.subheading: Enhance your content with trending, targeted data-backed keywords for maximum impact.

Simply upload your image to 2TAG, and our platform will analyze it to generate data-driven hashtags tailored for your content. Optimize your posts and boost visibility with algorithm-friendly keywords.

card.heading: What is Instabot?
card.subheading: Train a personal ai on your data and make images in your style in seconds.
card.description: Instabot acts as a real Instagram user, scraping explore page posts to collect data. It builds a shared library, allowing users to access both personal and collective information.

session.heading: Using Instabot for even more convenience

items.customize_niche: Customize the followed niche of your account
items.full_access: Full access of customized Instagram trend analysis reports
items.contribute: Contribute your ai model to community library

guide.heading: How to open and connect an Instabot
guide.subheading: Make your own ai model in around 10 minutes.

step1.heading: Create an Instagram account
step1.content: Create a new Instagram account in your device

step2.heading: Follow niche
step2.content: Follow other interested pages as you use Instagram as usual. We will take that area as your category for the Instabot.

step3.heading: Connect Insta-bot with us
step3.content: Enter your details for the Instagram account in our system. Wait for a moment for the Instabot to run. You are all set.
